**The SD card boot loop is fixed, and it was never about the display.** Since the first release, a board with a microSD card in the slot could boot, mount the card, and reboot three seconds later, forever. The flasher has carried a note telling you to take the card out. It was filed as a display-driver problem because the boards it showed on were the ILI9341 ones. They were also, it turns out, the boards that had cards in them. The card was mounted before Bluetooth, the mount took the memory Bluetooth needed a moment later, and Bluetooth's startup halts the whole board when it gets none. The card now mounts last, after both radios, and asks for a lot less. Tested on three boards with a 32 GB card: one boot each, radios up, card mounted, logging. The note on the flasher is gone.

**The duress PIN crashed instead of restarting quietly.** It did erase everything it should, so nobody was left with their secrets on the board, but it came back with a "that was not a clean boot" banner, which is the opposite of what a duress PIN is for. The wipe ran out of memory copying the settings it keeps, with the screen buffer still taking its share. The screen is let go first now, since the board restarts seconds later anyway. Watched over serial this time, start to finish.

**Getting this version:** from v1.7.4, UPDATE OVER WIFI or Bluetooth. From v1.7.3, WiFi. From anything older, the USB flasher.

## RL Phantom logs to its card now

It never had. The display and the SD slot were sharing one of the ESP32's two SPI engines, and the fix that stopped the card from killing touch in v1.7.2 did so by never clocking the card at all. The display and touch now have the other engine to themselves, and the card has its own bus, the way the 2.8" board is wired.

The board also says at boot whether the card mounted, and how big it is, or that no card answered. Until now the only way to know was to pull the card and look.

## Every screen in every theme, and every outfit in every pose

Two new emulator tests render all 23 screens in all 6 colour themes, and all 13 outfits through all 27 arm movements, and measure what a person would otherwise have to squint at. They found seven things, all fixed.

The highlighted LOG button, the EMOTE button and the active message tab kept a white label on the theme's highlight colour. In GH0ST that colour is white. The label now goes black on a pale highlight. The power saver and SquachMesh menus drew their rows straight onto the synthwave sun, and the diary's "tap anywhere to go back" hint had faded to nothing in every theme. Both fixed. The SQUAD badge and the unread bubble get the same treatment on pale themes.

Blue Blur's gloves stayed at his sides while his arms went up, and his shoes hung under his feet when he crouched. Snow Parka's mitten floated beside the hood mid-wave with no sleeve behind it. Wolf Pelt's hide hung beside the arm instead of on it. And a bow left a black cap floating above his head, which the tests could not see but you could. All on the hands, feet, arms and head now, wherever they are.

## Hold NEARBY

Press and hold the NEARBY headline and the closest device's card opens. v1.7.4 shipped this with a hold that cancelled itself if your thumb moved twelve pixels, which a thumb on a resistive panel does without asking, and the card then closed itself on the finger that opened it. Both fixed.

## The emulator, from a contributor

aroth made the PC emulator build on macOS and rebuilt its build system so an edit recompiles only what changed: a full build went from about a minute to twelve seconds, a one-file change to three. Thank you.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: a board with a microSD card in it could boot loop forever
- **Fixed**: the duress PIN crashed on its way to the quiet restart
- **Fixed**: the RL Phantom never wrote to its SD card
- **Fixed**: highlighted buttons and tabs unreadable in GH0ST and three other themes
- **Fixed**: power saver and SquachMesh rows drawn over the background picture; the diary hint invisible
- **Fixed**: Blue Blur's gloves and shoes, Snow Parka's mitten, Wolf Pelt's hide, and a bow's floating outline
- **Fixed**: holding NEARBY cancelled on a real touch panel, and its card dismissed itself
- **Added**: a boot line saying whether the SD card mounted
- **Added**: emulator tests for every screen in every theme and every outfit in every pose
- **Changed**: the flasher no longer tells you to take the card out
- **Changed**: the emulator builds on macOS and rebuilds in seconds (aroth)
